Yayra Browser

A browser built around your workspace.

Yayra is a cross-platform browser for opening websites and working with local browser tools. It includes tab and bookmark organization, downloads and document viewing, and optional Google account integrations.

Open Yayra

How Google integrations work

Google account connection is optional. Basic sign-in requests your Google account identity so Yayra can show which account you connected. Separate Google features ask for additional permission only when you choose them. Those permissions are read-only and are shown on Google's consent screen; you can decline or revoke access.

Depending on the feature you choose, requested Google API access can include Gmail, Drive, Calendar, Contacts, Photos, Tasks, Classroom courses, or YouTube. Yayra is not a Google product and is not endorsed by Google. Google services remain subject to Google's terms and privacy policy.
